sloka: तस्मात् आहार वीर्येण निसर्गेण च वानराः ।आयोजन शतात् साग्रात् वयम् पश्याम नित्यशः ॥४-५८-३२॥
transliteration: tasmāt āhāra vīryeṇa nisargeṇa ca vānarāḥ ।āyojana śatāt sāgrāt vayam paśyāma nityaśaḥ ॥4-58-32॥

translations.english: 'Our movement and vision naturally extends to distant places. For those fighting on foot, the movement is restricted to the extent of foot movement.
